about: Made by tools/art-import/import_art.py. Do not edit by hand; re-run the script.
frameFormat: [page, x, y, w, h, trimX, trimY, fullW, fullH]

move.note: heavy friendly waddle; play at any move speed

windup_rush.note: lasts exactly the telegraph (22 ticks). In Guided mode the wind-up holds: hold the last frame (intensity 1). telegraphIntensity: per-frame alpha (0..1) for the telegraph layer. It ramps up through the wind-up and fades smoothly through the first half of the attack (no hard cut). Multiply it into the tinted layer's alpha

rush.note: hot pot rush: the red circle around the pot is drawn by the game

call.note: calling 2 Spark Sprites (at 66% health): loop while they arrive

windup_pin.note: lasts exactly the telegraph (26 ticks). In Guided mode the wind-up holds: hold the last frame (intensity 1). telegraphIntensity: per-frame alpha (0..1) for the telegraph layer. It ramps up through the wind-up and fades smoothly through the first half of the attack (no hard cut). Multiply it into the tinted layer's alpha

pin.note: rolling pin lane (dash only): the purple-and-white stripes and '!!' are drawn by the game

stagger.note: dizzy wobble; loop for as long as the stagger lasts

defeat.note: dissolves into light and sparkles (a hopeful 'set free', not a death). The last frame is empty
